mapper.select: SELECT PROD_ID, CHANGE_DATE, cast(SUM(PROD_VALUE)/SUM(AMOUNT) as NUMBER(30,4)) PROD_VALUE, '02' as CHANG_TYPE, null as unitValueTotal FROM ( SELECT info.finprod_market_id AS PROD_ID, rul.EFF_DATE AS CHANGE_DATE, S.AMOUNT * rul.YIELD PROD_VALUE, S.AMOUNT, ifnull(rul.UPDATE_TIME,rul.CREATE_TIME) updatetime FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE rul left JOIN FIN_PRODUCT info on info.FINPROD_ID=rul.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO B ON rul.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION PS WHERE EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID,FINPROD_ID,MAX(CDATE) CDATE FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION WHERE CDATE < NOW() GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID,FINPROD_ID ) P LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = P.FINPROD_ID WHERE PS.PORTFOLIO_ID=P.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PS.FINPROD_ID=P.FINPROD_ID AND PS.CDATE=P.CDATE AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F24' ) ) S ON S.FINPROD_ID = info.finprod_id AND S.CDATE = rul.EFF_DATE WHERE info.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F24') AND info.PROFIT_TYPE = '02' and B.CASH_TYPE_1 = '02' AND S.HODING_TYPE = '03' AND DATE_FORMAT(rul.EFF_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d')=#{updatetime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND rul.BRANCH=0 and b.branch = 0 ---取母产品报价 ) P WHERE AMOUNT >0 GROUP BY PROD_ID, CHANGE_DATE
